steps.say: MarketNavi helps you navigate the crypto and stock markets. | Clear readings, AI guidance and alerts, with a community alongside. | Here's a quick tour of the dashboard.
On the left is the sidebar. | Your account, your communities, notifications, your watchlists, and settings.
A new account gets a short getting-started checklist: five first steps. | The day-one videos walk through each of them.
Quick Snapshot is the market at a glance. | Anything unusual today shows up here first.
Tides is the big picture: rates, the dollar, fear, and where money is flowing. | It sets the conditions every asset trades in.
Market sentiment scores the news headlines, for crypto and for stocks, from minus one hundred to plus one hundred.
The signal tables list your watchlist. | Each asset gets three readings: Trend, Stretch, and Flow. | They describe the market. They don't forecast it.
Click a name to bring that asset into focus. | The sections below the tables follow it.
The interactive chart shows its candles, with the readings drawn over time, and your own drawings.
Why these readings explains each score in plain words: what's pushing it, and what's holding it back.

Lattice is your research workspace. | Signal Groups and Signal Sets turn signals into your own questions. | Prism Scan checks them across your assets, and Funnels narrow the whole market down, stage by stage.
The AI Navigator slides out from the right edge. | Ask it anything about what's on your screen.
The arrow above it opens the community: social signals and chat about each asset.
That's the dashboard. | Next, the day-one guides: add your assets, then build your first Group, Set, scan and funnel.
